player_prompt.intro:
Uwuye Umukino {player_id} ukina {colour} ({piece}) mu mukino wa Othello.
Lits wa we ni uke kuwa na ibiko vyingi vy'uruhu kwenye buni ku mashingano ya mukino.
Ku ruhusa rwawe, weka ibiko uko rikwiriye umukino mukuru w'umukino wawe - mu kibanza (mu kibanza, mu kibanza cy'iburyo, cyangwa mu kibanza cy'iburyo)-hagati ya ibiko ryawe rishya na ryawe ry'ivu ry'umukino wawe. Ibiko vy'umukino w'umukino wawe vyose bizungurutwe ku ruhu rwawe.
Tanga ruhusa rwawe mu kibanza '[row, col]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Igikorwa cyo kwimura kigomba kuba muburyo [row, col].

game_action.skipped: Umukinnyi {pid} yagombaga kurenga ku mwanya we.

game_message.must_skip: Mugenzi {pid} ({piece}) nta zamu nziza afite, agomba kureka.
